name: warning
assumes: NetNameIndex.warningFor(net) for a net in the design, other than NC
KiCad names are judged on the label after the sheet path
edge_other means the edge whitespace includes U+00A0 or another non-ASCII space String.trim removes
edge_space means every leading and trailing character removed is U+0020; edge_other means at least one is another character String.trim removes (tab, NBSP, other Unicode spaces)
